tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, with no build type exempt from it. The project has also recorded a preference for https everywhere with no exceptions.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md`. It says that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, with no exemptions. That comes from decision #21, "verification on all builds", which replaced the earlier decision (#19) about dev builds. The paragraph doesn't describe the retired decision.

The paragraph also mentions the recorded "https everywhere, no exceptions" decision (#25). That is a related decision, not a verification decision.

There is also an older record, #23, "plain http for internal hosts". It pulls against #25, but it's about transport rather than certificate verification, so I left it out of the paragraph. It may deserve a look if you want the two reconciled.

The Muninn session-start check also reported a red heartbeat: 20 hook runs started and never finished. I haven't investigated it.
